question: Which of the following countries will host the 2025 G20 Summit for the first time on the African continent?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**South Africa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **South Africa** will host the **2025 G20 Summit**, marking the first time the summit will be held on the **African continent.**
 
• This decision aligns with the G20’s aim to promote **global inclusivity** and expand representation of regions like **Africa** in global decision-making forums.
